author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads N-able N-sight RMM failing checks: a JSON record each time a check starts failing or clears. The bridge in bridges/n-able-n-sight-failing-checks polls list_failing_checks and posts the records to HTTP Ingest. Each record goes to the third-party alert schema.
notes:
Setup:
- N-sight RMM has no syslog, webhook or audit log export, and its Data Extraction API has no technician activity log.
- bridges/n-able-n-sight-failing-checks polls list_failing_checks and posts a JSON record when a check starts failing or clears.

Field mapping:
- Each record goes to the third-party alert schema with the device, the check description and output, client and site.
- The record keys are the bridge's, holding the fields of N-able's documented XML.
- N-sight gives no severity.

Time:
- The event time is when the bridge saw the change.

Made up in the samples:
- Check types, descriptions and outputs in the samples are made up.

Testing:
- Passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-13 (52 of 52 fields matched the emulator).
- No built-in parser claimed these lines in 5 Run Tests.

Known gaps:
- Security-relevant checks (antivirus, event log, Windows service, backup) show up this way; logins, remote sessions and script runs don't, because N-sight doesn't expose them.
